items.text: You mayhaveseena demonstration ofconvection currentsin water,like the one shown inFigure 15.4.Thewaterisheated just under the purple crystal and thecrystal coloursthewaterasitdissolves,which letsyou see the movement inthe water.Theheated waterexpandsand becomesless dense than the coldersurrounding water,soit floatsup tothe top of the glassbeaker.Colder water sinks to takeitsplace,and is then heated too.At the top,the wam water starts to cool,becomesmore dense again andwill begin to sink,so a circulating current isset upin the water.Thisis called a convection current.
